Visa & Legal Compliance: eVisa online for 100+ nationalities (https://www.evisa.gov.tr/). Visa on arrival for some (more expensive). Passport valid 6 months beyond stay. Some nationalities visa-free.

Climate & Weather: Varied. Istanbul: 5°C (Jan) to 28°C (July). Antalya (coast): 10°C to 35°C. Ankara (inland): 0°C to 30°C. Eastern Turkey: -10°C to 25°C. Check specific destination. Hot dry summers, mild winters coast.

Apparel Sourcing: Conservative dress norms. Modest clothing recommended, especially outside tourist areas/İstanbul. Religious sites: cover shoulders/knees, women may need headscarf. Size system: European.

arrival24h.simple: Power: 220V, 50Hz, Type C/F sockets. 4G/5G good, eSIM available. NFC contactless growing. Istanbul M1/M3 metro to city center.
arrival24h.detailed:
Electrical Infrastructure: 220V, 50Hz. Type C (Europlug) and Type F (Schuko) sockets. Visual reference: https://www.power-plugs-sockets.com/type-f/

Connectivity & ISP: Average broadband 50+ Mbps. 4G coverage 95%, 5G in cities. ISPs: Turkcell, Vodafone TR, Türk Telekom. Tourist eSIM: Airalo, Holafly. Local SIM: Turkcell Tourist Pack (~$40/week).

Financial Rails: NFC contactless growing (Troy, Bonus). Cash still widely used. No mobile money. Papara for P2P. Tipping: 5-10% in restaurants, round up for small services.

Airport-to-City: Istanbul IST: M1/M3 Metro (₺12, 45min) or Havaist bus (₺18, 60-90min). Sabiha Gökçen: Havabus (₺18, 60min) or taxi (~₺250-300). Official taxi: metered, tip not required.

mobility.simple: Istanbul Metro/Marmaray (extensive). Dolmuş (shared minibuses) informal transit. BiTaksi, Uber (limited). Bike share limited. Walkability variable, hills.
mobility.detailed:
Urban Transit Grids: Istanbul: Metro, Marmaray (under rail), tram, bus, ferry. Istanbulkart card (integrated). Ankara: Metro, Ankaray. İzmir: Metro, İZBAN. Apps: Istanbulkart Mobil, Moovit.

Informal Transit: Dolmuş (shared minibuses) operating fixed routes, depart when full. Yellow taxis informal in some areas. Informal transit significant in Istanbul.

Micro-Mobility & Ride-Hailing: BiTaksi (official taxi app). Uber limited (licensed taxis only, no private cars). No Bolt. Bike-sharing: İsbike (limited cities). E-scooters: limited.

Pedestrian Infrastructure: Variable. Excellent in modern districts (Kadıköy, Beşiktaş). Crowded in tourist areas (Sultanahmet). Hills in Istanbul. Sidewalk quality varies. Pedestrian crossings: zebra crossings common but cars may not yield.

dailyLiving.simple: Delivery: Yemeksepeti, Getir, Trendyol. Alcohol: state monopoly (Tekel) ended, supermarket sales. Pharmacy: many OTC, antibiotics Rx. Tap water: boil or bottle.
dailyLiving.detailed:
E-Commerce & Delivery: Dominant: Yemeksepeti (food), Getir (grocery instant), Trendyol (shopping). Local: Banabici. Grocery delivery: Migros, CarrefourSA. 24/7 Getir delivery culture.

Retail & Alcohol: Open sales in supermarkets, specialty shops. Former state monopoly (Tekel) ended. Drinking age 18. Raki culture (aniseed spirit). Tipping expected.

Pharmacy: Many OTC medications. Antibiotics Rx-only. Pharmacies marked with green cross. Eczane nöbetçi (on-duty pharmacies).

Beverage & Dietary: **Tap water not safe** in most areas - boil or use bottled water. Zero-sugar options available. Local: ayran (yogurt drink), Turkish tea, Turkish coffee. Çay (tea) culture pervasive.

Buffet Protocols: Hotel buffets: multi-plate common. Traditional: one-plate with refills. Open buffet common in restaurants. Sharing dishes typical. No restrictions on refills.

socialCode.simple: Gifts: avoid alcohol for conservative hosts, Turkish delight OK. Shoes removed in homes. Dog-friendly in cities. Hospitality, respect elders, tea ritual.
socialCode.detailed:
Gift-Giving Etiquette: Flowers: odd numbers preferred. Avoid alcohol for conservative hosts. Turkish delight, tea/coffee sets, regional textiles excellent gifts. Host gifts expected for dinner.

Household Norms: Shoes removed in homes. Slippers provided. separate bathroom shoes often.

Companion Pet Culture: Dog-friendly in cities, less in rural areas. Dogs in restaurants (patios). Stray dogs common in cities (generally friendly). Cat culture strong.

Behavioral Matrix: Collectivist, hospitality-focused. Tea/coffee ritual for guests. Respect for elders. Indirect communication. Punctuality: 15-30 min grace socially. Tipping: 5-10% expected. Physical greetings: handshake, or kiss on cheek (close friends). Business cards: two-handed exchange. Dining: tea served with meals, late dinners common.

preArrival.simple: Do not assume commercial flights are operating to your destination. Check current government travel advice and Ukrainian transport updates; entry rules depend on your passport.
preArrival.detailed:
Route planning: Security conditions and aviation operations can change. Do not rely on Google Flights, Skyscanner, or an old itinerary alone; confirm current airspace and carrier operations through official sources and follow your government's travel advice. Ukrzaliznytsia publishes official rail information and booking links; cross-border routes and connections can change at short notice.

Entry rules: Visa requirements depend on nationality, purpose, and stay. Check Ukraine's MFA guidance and the relevant embassy before departure.

Climate and packing: Conditions vary from the Black Sea coast to the Carpathians. Check the forecast for every region and season; use layers, rain protection, and sturdy footwear.

arrival24h.simple: Ukraine uses 220 V / 50 Hz Type C and F sockets. Power and mobile service can be interrupted; carry a charged power bank and check current local alerts.
arrival24h.detailed:
Power: 220 V / 50 Hz, Type C and F sockets. Check your device label and adapter before use. Electricity availability can change with local conditions; keep essential devices charged when possible.

Connectivity and payments: Check roaming or eSIM coverage with your provider. Keep offline maps and important addresses; service can be interrupted. The local currency is the hryvnia (UAH). Cards are common in cities, but keep some cash for outages or small purchases.

Arrival and onward travel: Confirm the operating status of the airport and border crossing before travel. For rail, use official Ukrzaliznytsia schedules and booking links. Follow official alerts and instructions at stations.

mobility.simple: Use current official city-transit and Ukrzaliznytsia updates. Service may change with security alerts; follow local air-raid instructions and shelter guidance.
mobility.detailed:
Kyiv and other cities: Metro, bus, tram, and trolleybus services operate by municipality; check the local operator's current service notices, hours, and ticketing. Air-raid alerts can interrupt service or change access; follow official instructions and know the nearest shelter.

Intercity: Ukrzaliznytsia is the primary official rail source. Confirm schedules, station changes, and boarding details on the day of travel.

Taxis and walking: Check current availability of licensed taxi apps at your location and confirm the pickup point. Avoid photographing transport, military, or infrastructure sites where restricted; use marked crossings and follow local security notices.

dailyLiving.simple: Glovo and grocery delivery cover some Ukrainian cities; check your exact address. Follow local notices for water, electricity, pharmacy hours, and payment access.
dailyLiving.detailed:
Delivery: Check Glovo or local listings at the exact address; coverage and operating hours vary by city and can change with local conditions. Confirm phone-number, payment, and delivery instructions in the app.

Pharmacy and water: Ask your accommodation about current local water guidance and open pharmacies. Bring necessary medicines in original packaging and verify import rules. Keep essential supplies for possible service interruptions.

Payments and food: Use Ukrainian hryvnia (UAH); card and mobile payment availability may be affected by power or network interruptions. Check receipts for service charges and ask about ingredients or dietary needs.

socialCode.simple: Ask which language a person prefers; do not assume Ukrainian and Russian are interchangeable. Follow air-raid, photography, and security instructions without exception.
socialCode.detailed:
Language and introductions: Ukrainian is the state language, and language preferences vary by person and region. Ask politely which language your counterpart prefers; do not assume that Ukrainian and Russian are interchangeable.

Home and hospitality: Ask about footwear and gift preferences when visiting. A small food gift can be appropriate, but follow the host's lead and ask about dietary needs.

Security and photography: Follow air-raid alerts, shelter instructions, and restrictions on photographing people, transport, military activity, or infrastructure. Do not publish location-sensitive images. Customs differ by household; avoid national-character generalizations.
